answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the reef of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the delta is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
